description: brink-desktop main window: core + the folder-picker dialog. File I/O goes through the shell's own guarded commands, not the fs plugin. `core:window:allow-destroy` is not in `core:window:default` (#2370) — the quit path needs it to force-close the window after the awaited save, bypassing another `closeRequested` round-trip. `shell:allow-execute` is scoped to exactly the `brink-cli` sidecar (D3, #2392) — the shell plugin's default permission set does not grant sidecar execution, and this scope is additionally narrowed at the `run_cli` command by a fixed subcommand allowlist, so a compromised webview can reach only `export-xliff` / `compile-locale` / `regenerate-xliff` / `compile`, never arbitrary process args.
